title: 2 UFOs Reported Halloween Week In Over Southern Idaho Skies
excerpt: Two UAPs were reported in southern Idaho between October 24 and 28, 2026.
content:
Halloween week has passed, but not without reports of tricks in the skies above the Gem State by unidentified objects seen by multiple witnesses.

An unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP) investigation center in Washington State recently published reports on two separate incidents involving unexplained crafts spotted by Southern Idaho witnesses between October 24 and October 28, 2026.

The first incident was reported over Boise, while the other reported sighting took place in southeastern Idaho.

Two UAPs Reported To National Investigation Center Between Oct 24 and Oct 28 Over Idaho

Two incidents involving separate sightings of UAPs the week of Halloween in the Gem State were reported to the National UFO Reporting Center in Washington State. Both sightings involved single crafts at altitudes of less than 1,200 feet.

READ MORE: Idaho Witness Reports Swarm Of Orb UFOs Over Sand Dunes

On October 24, a single witness reported a large object, light in color, traveling at a high rate of speed from a vehicle on Heise Road in Ririe, 300 miles east of Boise. This investigation is currently open and filed under incident report number 201970.

Just four days later, another UAP described as 'triangular,' with an approximate size of 50 yards, was spotted in southwestern Idaho. The Boise sighting took place shortly after 8 P.M. on October 28, when the craft was reported as moving in a southeastern direction with three distinct lights visible in the sky. This incident is detailed in report number 20206.

If you witnessed either UAP between October 24 and October 28 in Ririe or Boise, please contact the NUFORC and provide further details to investigators.
